name: chainskills
description: Stack-agnostic skills for any blockchain project, new or existing, that can extend themselves: design, specs, consensus, staking, rollups, randomness, verifiable participation, tokenomics, governance, smart contracts, stack adapters (Cosmos SDK / Ignite / Cosmos EVM, EVM L1, OP Stack, Arbitrum chains, ZK Stack), security, testing and formal verification.
